items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] “Keeping the proper strings muted.” That reminds me of Bucky Pizzarelli telking about Freddie Green...

ctx.x: Exactly. It’s one way. It’s absolutely that you know. It’s funny. But it’s a fun challenge and we love recording for that reason particularly is like we can really focus on — you know when I’m on stage I love to perform and rock out and connect with the crowd and look at the crowd and not my fingers if you don’t need to and jump up and down. And with the excitement of jumping up and down comes a real focus on not pulling your strings and falling slightly out of tune. So it’s nice to not have that going on as well…
“Keeping the proper strings muted.” That reminds me of Bucky Pizzarelli telking about Freddie Green and the way he strummed, and that a lot of his strumming was only two or three strings.
